pages.title: Paper notes
pages.description: Short, policy-facing explainers of selected publications. Bibliographic records stay on the Publications pages.

pages.title: Access to mental health care and suicide rates
pages.description: Expanded mental health access through psychologist scope-of-practice deregulation can reduce suicide mortality by 3 percent.

pages.title: AI-enhanced study groups and learning outcomes
pages.description: Experimental evaluation finds that carefully designed AI tutoring improves learning outcomes by helping students reason rather than providing answers.

pages.title: Athletic reclassification and local entrepreneurial ecosystems
pages.description: Upward college athletic reclassification increases local sales and employment more than business formation; effects travel farther for higher-profile moves and larger for football.

pages.title: Investigating reproducibility in the social and behavioral sciences
pages.description: Systematic audit of reproducibility assesses whether published analyses can be reproduced from original datasets and code.

pages.title: Investigating replicability in the social and behavioral sciences
pages.description: Systematic replication study examines replicability of published findings across social and behavioral sciences, identifying patterns in which result types successfully replicate.

pages.title: Hospital ownership and profits when a neighbor closes
pages.description: For-profit hospitals increase charge-to-cost and profit margins after neighboring closures; non-profit and governmental hospitals show minimal financial gains.

pages.title: Covert regime change and ideology
pages.description: Covert regime change operations' ideology shapes intervention outcomes and post-intervention governance quality across historical cases.

pages.title: What do women gain from successful revolutions
pages.description: Nonviolent revolutions improve women's empowerment more robustly than violent revolutions, particularly in political participation and civil liberties.

pages.title: Social movements and market legitimacy
pages.description: Successful nonviolent campaigns strengthen liberal democracy, rule of law, and market-supporting institutions more than violent campaigns.

pages.title: Prescription opioid spillovers from retail pharmacies
pages.description: Must-access PDMP mandates reduce retail opioid sales within enacting states but generate cross-border spillover effects in neighboring voluntary PDMP states.

pages.title: Scope-of-practice regulations and PA inter-state relocation
pages.short_title: PA scope of practice and relocation
pages.description: Optimal scope-of-practice laws increase PA interstate relocation by 3%; effect strongest in rural areas.

pages.title: Maternity care deserts in North Carolina
pages.description: Stub paper note for Sugg et al. (2025) in The Journal of Rural Health. Summary not verified yet.

pages.title: Pharmacist prescriptive authority in Idaho
pages.description: Pharmacist prescriptive authority in Idaho increased Medicare Part D claims for albuterol and insulin pen needles, providing approximately three additional patients per pharmacist timely care.

pages.title: Substance use Certificate-of-Need laws and treatment access
pages.description: Certificate-of-Need laws reduce spatial accessibility to substance use treatment by 10 percent, with larger effects for medications like buprenorphine.

pages.title: Firm responsiveness to environmental policy in shale production
pages.description: Increased drilling bonding requirements cause firms to exit shale industry rather than comply; creates judgment-proof problem leaving environmental cleanup to states.

pages.title: Revolutions and corruption
pages.description: Successful nonviolent and violent revolutions produce null effects on corruption; violent revolutions actually induce higher corruption when controlling for education effects.

pages.title: Nurse practitioner scope of practice and opioid prescribing
pages.description: Full autonomy in nurse practitioner scope of practice does not affect opioid prescribing behavior or patient safety outcomes.

pages.title: Military spouse RN licensing and care access
pages.description: Full recognition of military spouse licenses increases employment mobility probability by 12%; restrictive reforms have the opposite effect, providing job stability.

pages.title: Hospital ownership changes and charge-to-cost shifts
pages.description: Hospital transitions to for-profit ownership increase charge-to-cost ratios by 161% versus governmental and 99.7% versus non-profit hospitals.

pages.title: Grading policy, email nudges, and grade outcomes
pages.description: Email reminders to low-performing students improved exam scores by 22-28 points out of 50, a 44-56 percent improvement.

pages.title: Anti-maintenance of certification and elderly physician supply
pages.description: Anti-MOC state laws increase the supply of older physicians, with larger effects in states implementing full prohibition.

pages.title: Cultural influences on gender gap in test scores in Afghanistan
pages.description: Cultural influences significantly affect gender gap in test scores on Afghanistan's university entrance examination, informing education policy in post-conflict contexts.

pages.title: APRN full practice authority, supply, and outcomes
pages.description: Stub paper note for Bae, Norris, Shakya, and Timmons (2023) in Policy, Politics, and Nursing Practice. Summary not verified yet.

pages.title: Prescription drug monitoring programs and opioid prescribing
pages.description: Must-access PDMPs cut county retail opioid prescribing, with evidence of cross-border shopping into voluntary-access states.

pages.title: Do public libraries help mitigate crime
pages.description: Public library openings reduce nearby crime rates; effects are localized and vanish at greater distances from the library.

pages.title: Nurse practitioner FPA, workforce diversity, and access
pages.description: Stub paper note for Plemmons et al. (2022) in Policy, Politics, and Nursing Practice. Summary not verified yet.

pages.title: Spatial spillovers and the productivity-compensation gap
pages.description: Accounting for productivity spillovers across state boundaries significantly narrows the productivity-compensation gap, explaining meaningful portions of wage stagnation.

pages.title: Shale revolution, oil and gas prices, and drilling
pages.description: Information spillover between drilling/investment and energy prices increased significantly post-2007 during shale boom.

pages.title: Productivity spillovers and the productivity-compensation gap
pages.description: Accounting for spatial and trade-network productivity spillovers narrows the productivity-compensation gap in some industries but effects vary significantly.

pages.title: Nurse licensure compact and mobility
pages.description: Nurse Licensure Compact adoption increased nurse mobility by 11% among registered and practical/vocational nurses within compact states.

pages.title: Natural disasters and labor migration in Nepal
pages.description: 2015 Nepal earthquake increased international labor migration by 1.5 percentage points in severely affected districts.

pages.title: Must-access PDMPs and retail opioid sales
pages.description: Must-access PDMP policies reduce retail sales of some opioids (hydrocodone, morphine) but not others (oxycodone); effects vary by drug type.

pages.title: Medicaid expansion and opioid supply policies
pages.description: Combination of Medicaid expansion and pain management clinic laws can balance opioid supply reduction with treatment access; strongest effects with both policies.

pages.title: The fracking boom and crime rates in rural American states
pages.description: Fracking boom states (Arkansas, North Dakota, West Virginia) experienced significantly higher crime rates with estimated annual victimization cost of $15.68M; effect specific to rural states.

pages.title: Economic freedom and startup formation
pages.description: Regulatory freedom significantly increases startup density, while government spending and tax freedom decrease startup formation; business deregulation drives entrepreneurship.

pages.title: Temporal actions under uncertainty in crowdfunding campaigns
pages.description: Heightened uncertainty shifts crowdfunding campaign timing; slower pre-launch pace and longer post-launch initiation reduce performance, but faster post-launch updates improve it.

pages.title: Political economy of Vermont's anti-fracking movement
pages.description: Legislative voting on Vermont's fracking ban was driven primarily by legislator ideology and party affiliation, not constituent demand or regional economic factors.

pages.title: Political economy of Vermont's abortion bill
pages.description: Political-economy analysis identifies interest group dynamics and political factors that shaped Vermont's abortion bill.

pages.title: Replication of Bersani and Doherty 2013
pages.description: Structured replication attempt of Bersani and Doherty (2013) criminology research through SCORE project examines robustness of original empirical claims.

pages.title: Scope of practice and NP mobility serving Medicare beneficiaries
pages.description: Full-practice nurse practitioner states attract and retain NPs; practitioners are 5.7% more likely to relocate to full-practice versus restrictive states.

pages.title: Announcement effects in US lumber futures market
pages.description: Lumber futures market announcements cause temporary price volatility spikes (3-5 days) with larger magnitude effects on more volatile contract months.

pages.title: Federal regulations and US energy sector output
pages.description: Federal regulations and U.S. energy sector output follow an inverted U-shape; low regulations increase output, but excess regulations lead to declining output.

pages.title: Electricity consumption and economic growth in Nepal
pages.description: Electricity consumption and economic growth show significant positive relationship in Nepal's resource-rich landlocked economy using time-series analysis.

pages.title: Quotas and reservations to ensure equity in Nepal
pages.description: Decision tree models using 14 practical questions predict household poverty in Nepal with 70-94% accuracy, enabling targeted quota and reservation allocation to poorest households.
